answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 35753 Country: India Title: Is it allowable in Islam to cut extra hair grown over eyebrow and ear of old aged male? Question: Is it allowable in Islam to cut extra hair grown over eyebrow and ear of old aged male? Answer ID: 35753 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 51/38/B=1433) Yes, it may be cut. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
